trade_rules_of_thumb: Bots trade off latest.json trade_board (formula 1.0.0). Manager intel uses the curated 1-100 scale in this packet. Do not mix the two.
Superflex: healthy named QB1s are premium. Huntley is a hedge not a 45. Willis is a 28 GUESS SF2, not Allen.
Half-PPR: WRs hold. Committee RBs cap unless they have a path to 15+ touches.
10-team benches are shallow. Do not pay a 2nd for a 4th RB. Depth pieces are leftovers.
Side getting the best player gives extra in 2-for-1 / 3-for-1.
Do not smash-sell a Wednesday DNP (Gibbs / Chase / Amon-Ra) or a mild return (Lamar FP).
IR is a discount not a drop if the player was a starter (Pierce is an 8, not a stash).
Bye-week sit is not a trade-down (CMC 72 / Purdy 76 / Nabers 64).
McConkey 12 GUESS is a protocol start-lean, not a buy-up to WR2.
